description.narrative: The Consortuim Agoratoire and Ikam is the organiser , the platform to facilitate the launch of the NOW-Nous Awards on national level in collaboration with The Spindle of Partos . It is a platform which recognize inspiring inclusive initiatives from Africa and Asia that promote diversity and inclusion and encourage self-empowerment of rights holder groups and communities. The event NOW-Nous Awards coincides with the Partos Innovation Festival held every October in Amsterdam. Objective of Celebrating Inclusion is to bring together the voices of rightsholders and, through an award, highlight unsung efforts to bring us closer to a responsive and inclusive society. The present project lead by Agoratoire and Ikam focused on innovative way to organise the national festival and partcipate an global level. The consortium organizes innovative events and festivals to amplify the voices of rights holders at the lnational level,supported by the production of documents, creative approches to reach rightholders, social medias using, and coaching and mentors activities. several innovatives activities has implemented invoved others stakeholders and agency.

participating-org.narrative:
Agoratoire is a "promotional space for Arts and Culture", and a cultural and artistic organization created in 2008 by some studentsof the Conservatory of Mali. The members are composed, among others, of young musicians, singers, slam/ spoken word artists, playwrights, storytellers, filmmakers, visual artists and designers. Together, we work for the promotion of arts and culture in Mali and on the international scene.
Agoratoire called "Maison Agoratoire" whose purpose is to educate, inform, train and educate, promote art and culture. We welcome and train young people to write and do oral and scenic performance. We also organise national and international cultural and artistic residencies and scenes.
Agoratoire is primarily a cultural space and promotes art and culture, but we do this with a social mission. We believe that art can bring people together, who then learn from each other by creating together. In that regard we promote peace and reconciliation, diversity, girls andwomen#s rights, and social inclusion. We conduct educational and fun activities and do our actions with the most disadvantaged and vulnerable people in society; with them, not for them. Agoratoire is a pioneer, being a cultural organization working with people with disabilities
